description: This file contains utility functions for image preprocessing and decoding ImageNet predictions, including a global variable for class index mapping.

methods.name: preprocess_input
methods.description: Preprocesses a tensor encoding a batch of images by converting RGB to BGR and zero-centering by mean pixel values.

methods.name: decode_predictions
methods.description: Decodes the predictions of an ImageNet model, returning top class predictions with class name, description, and score.
